DONNELLY, John (Jockser) (Swords) - June 19th, 2022, (peacefully) at Beaumont Hospital. Beloved husband of the late Theresa. Sadly missed by his loving sons Thomas, Sean and Philip, daughters Frances, Tina, Mary and Marice, sons-in-law, daughters-in-law, grandchildren, great-grandchildren, brothers-in-law Jim and Tom. relatives and friends. 

 

May he Rest In Peace. 

 

Reposing at Rock's Funeral Home, Swords on Wednesday (22nd June) evening from 4 - 6 p.m. Removal on Thursday (June 23rd) morning to St. Cronan’s Church, Brackenstown arriving for 10 a.m. Mass followed by funeral to Swords Cemetery. You can view the funeral mass live on the church webcam through the following link.

 

Webcam link: https://www.mcnmedia.tv/Camera/st-cronans-church-brackenstown-swords

 

Messages of sympathy for John's family can be left in the condolences section below.
